node.title: Re: Creating reverse dictionary
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As [GrandFather] [id://1229585|said], the issue you describe definitely sounds like an encoding issue. In terms of sorting, you might be interested in [doc://Unicode::Collate]:

use warnings;
use strict;
use Unicode::Collate;
use utf8;
use open qw/:std :utf8/;

my @words=('två','tvagit','ägg','agget','öga','ogallrad','Offerdal');

my @rev = map {scalar reverse} @words;
my @sorted = Unicode::Collate->new->sort(@rev);

print "$_\n" for @sorted;

__END__
